title: Plaid contact
description: A navy-to-cyan-to-mint gradient band under a thin rainbow hairline: a 70px lime-to-white gradient headline on the left and, on the right, a white form card with 40px corners inside a rainbow rim (two columns of navy-outlined fields, a select, a small grey consent line, a teal-to-cyan pill). Under them a lavender pill note with plum text and a purple gradient link. On phones everything stacks into one column.
notes: the band's colours come from foreground, glow and highlight, like plaid-hero
leaves 2.5rem of extra band at the bottom so plaid-footer (overlap) can round its top corners over it
the form is markup only: it posts to `action`
